about_the_game:
Shroomer is a relaxed open-world VR fantasy where you play as a mystical mushroom forager, entrusted by the kingdom to manage a secret enchanted forest.

Gather rare fungi and magical vegetation, process them into powerful elixirs, and complete unique quests for the kingdom and its inhabitants. But beware—some mushrooms are volatile, capable of exploding, releasing toxic spores, or reacting in unpredictable ways.

Use tools, knowledge, and alchemy to safely harvest and prepare ingredients. Build and upgrade crafting stations to cook shrooms and brew elixirs that unlock new abilities and paths.

Quests vary in timing and complexity—some must be completed before time runs out, while others are only available at night. Learn where and when different mushrooms grow. Real-world foraging experience will help you early on, but the forest has its own mysterious species you'll need to learn.

Explore biomes, discover hidden magic, and immerse yourself in the unique game atmosphere. Your choices shape your journey—and the forest is watching.

Will you become a master of shroomcraft, or will the forest claim you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590, AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • VR Support: OpenXR - Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3S, or OpenXR on SteamVR with HTC Vive, HTC Vive Pro 2, Valve Index
  • Additional Notes: Other headsets are not tested.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: In this open-world relaxed VR fantasy, you are Shroomer, a mystical forager tasked with managing a secret enchanted forest. Gather rare fungi and vegetation, craft elixirs, build tools and complete tasks. Handle dangerous mushrooms with special approach or risk being claimed by the forest’s magic.
